Cape Cod Five Cents Savings Bank, known as Cape Cod 5, is a mutual community bank founded in 1855 with more than $5.7 billion in assets, per its[about page](https://www.capecodfive.com/about-us) , and headquartered in Hyannis, Massachusetts. Small bank, big internship: the summer program welcomed about 60 interns chosen from nearly 700 applications in 2024, according to the bank's[LinkedIn announcement](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/cape-cod-five-cents-savings-bank_we-are-excited-to-welcome-60-interns-to-the-activity-7211413033695219712-wmO0) , and Vault ranks it[#5 among Best Financial Services Internships](https://vault.com/internship-program/financial-services/cape-cod-5-internship-program/internship-opportunities) for 2026. Interns spread across 15-plus departments, from internal audit and lending to marketing and wealth management, and the GPA floor sits around 3.0 rather than the 3.5 big banks expect.


So this guide covers the expected summer 2027 timeline, the departments, pay, eligibility, and the (genuinely easy) interview, reconstructed from prior cycles.

## What Is a Cape Cod 5 Internship?


A Cape Cod 5 internship is a paid, full-time summer placement of at least 10 weeks inside one department of a $5.7 billion mutual bank. The[official program page](https://www.capecodfive.com/internship-opportunities-cape-cod-5) promises real projects, exposure to senior leaders, workshops and volunteer work with local nonprofits, and it offers both onsite and hybrid arrangements depending on the department. Because Cape Cod 5 is a mutual bank with no stockholders, earnings go back into the community, and that shapes the culture interns describe: Glassdoor gives it 4.9/5 on culture and values and 96% of employees would recommend it. Vault's 2026 rankings place the program #5 in Financial Services, #8 for Finance, and #18 for Training & Mentoring.


So what's the catch? Scale. Roughly 60 interns join each summer, and you need to be on Cape Cod for it. For a student who wants hands-on banking exposure without a 3.5 GPA and a Wall Street cover letter, that's a feature.


## When Do Cape Cod 5 Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


Cape Cod 5 works on a short, quiet calendar. Postings appear on the UKG job board in late winter, interviews run through spring, and the class arrives in early June, when the bank posts its welcome photos on LinkedIn and Facebook. There's no published open date and no deadline, which is why the Glassdoor advice from a summer 2025 intern is simply to apply early.


But every date below except "now" is an expected date, projected from the 2024, 2025 and 2026 cohort timing and a Glassdoor interview dated February 2025 for that summer.


Now · September 2026 YOU ARE HERE

Expected posting window for summer 2027 on the UKG job board. Review is rolling, and prior cohorts drew roughly 700 applications for about 60 seats. Apply the day your target department posts, and check the board weekly because postings appear department by department.


~Feb – Apr 2027


Expected interviews for summer 2027: an initial screen, then a one-on-one behavioral conversation with the hiring manager, occasionally a second round. Glassdoor rates it 2/5 difficulty with 100% positive experiences across seven reviews.


~Mar – May 2027


Expected offers for summer 2027. Interviewees on Glassdoor report accepting quickly, and the small-team structure means days to weeks between interview and decision. Sort out Cape housing early if you're coming from off-Cape.


Early Jun – mid Aug 2027


Summer 2027 internship: at least 10 weeks, 40 hours a week, in Hyannis or a banking center, with leadership workshops, senior-leader exposure and nonprofit volunteer days. Cape Cod 5 doesn't publish a return-offer rate, but LinkedIn shows former interns accepting full-time roles.


*How to read this page: our dates come from tracking previous recruiting cycles and daily posting data. Treat them as informed estimates based on historical patterns, not confirmed dates. The company's official careers page is always the most current source. If a role is posted there, go by that, even if this page suggests the window hasn't opened yet.*


### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


So why treat a bank with no deadline as if it had one? Because roughly 700 applications chase about 60 seats, and the bank reviews them as they arrive. A Glassdoor reviewer who interned in summer 2025 put it plainly: apply early, because they accept on a rolling basis. Departments post separately, so the Internal Audit or Wealth Management seat you want may fill in February while Retail Banking is still open in April. At Cape Cod 5 the interview is a conversation, not a test, so timing matters more than polish.

## Which Cape Cod 5 Internship Programs Should You Target?


Cape Cod 5 places interns across the bank rather than into a single program. Vault lists audit, lending and marketing "and more," and cross-referencing Glassdoor, Indeed and the bank's own intern testimonials turns up 15-plus departments. The seven below are the ones with the most public detail.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Cape Cod 5 sets a low bar on paper and a high bar on attitude. Requirements below come from the Vault profile and the official program page; where the bank hasn't stated a rule, we say so.


• **Class year:** Current college students; program language about building on academic learning points to rising juniors and seniors, but no explicit gate is published


• **GPA:** Minimum 3.00–3.49 per the Vault profile


• **Majors:** Any; finance, accounting, business, marketing, IT and economics are the most common fits by department


• **Work authorization:** Not stated on the program page; as a US community bank, assume US work authorization is required and confirm with the recruiter


• **School credit:** Credit approval forms are considered on request


• **Geography:** Open to students from any school (recent interns came from as far as the University of South Florida), but you must work onsite or hybrid on Cape Cod for the summer


### Does Cape Cod 5 Have a GPA Cutoff for Interns?


But is 3.0 a hard line? Vault lists the minimum as a 3.00 to 3.49 range, which is already well under the 3.5 that bulge-bracket programs expect, and the range format suggests judgment rather than an automatic screen. Glassdoor interview reports describe the process as conversational and behavioral, with questions about customer-facing experience and why you want to work at Cape Cod 5. So a 3.1 with a summer of retail or hospitality work and a clear reason for choosing a mutual bank will beat a 3.7 with neither.

## What Is the Cape Cod 5 Application and Interview Process Like?


Cape Cod 5 runs one of the simplest interview processes in banking: no case study, no online assessment, no HireVue. What does it look like?


So here's the sequence from the Vault profile and seven Glassdoor interview reports, all of them positive.


1. **Apply on the UKG job board** linked from the program page. Two-thirds of Glassdoor reviewers applied online; the rest came through referrals or campus contacts.


2. **Recruiter review** : per Vault, the recruiter reviews your resume, qualifications and stated interests and schedules an interview matched to a department.


3. **Initial screen** : a short phone or online conversation. One 2026 Consumer Banking intern called the process "incredibly fair and straightforward."


4. **Behavioral interview, one-on-one** : why Cape Cod 5, your customer-facing experience, where you see yourself in five years, and what you'd bring to the team. Reviewers describe it as easy-going and conversational.


5. **Possible second interview** : some departments add one; most candidates report a single round.


6. **Offer** : quick, often within days to a couple of weeks, given the small-team structure.


Glassdoor rates the interview 2/5 for difficulty with a 100% positive experience across seven reviews, and every reported format was one-on-one. Prepare answers, not frameworks. The[awards page](https://www.capecodfive.com/awards-recognition) is worth a read before you go in; referencing a specific recognition shows you did your homework.

## How Do You Stand Out at Cape Cod 5?


What separates the 60 who get in from the 700 who apply? Three things, none of them technical. First, apply the day postings appear and name a department. With 15-plus tracks, the recruiter matches you by stated interest, so "I want the Internal Audit track because I've done control testing coursework" lands far better than "I'd like a banking internship."


So second, lead with customer-facing experience. The interview asks about it directly, and retail, hospitality, tutoring and any client-facing summer job count. Pair it with one concrete story about resolving a problem for a customer.


And third, show you understand what a mutual bank is. Cape Cod 5 has no stockholders, reinvests earnings locally, and is proud of its recognitions: Vault #5, a Boston Globe Top Place to Work award for its parent Mutual Bancorp, and American Banker's Best Banks to Work For. Mention one of those, say why the community model appeals to you, and if you're from off-Cape, say you're excited to spend a summer on the Cape. The bank takes its regional identity seriously and hires people who appreciate it.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Cape Cod 5 internship?


No. The 2026 summer class was welcomed in June 2026, and the program runs a single summer intake. Summer 2027 postings are expected on the UKG job board around January to March 2027, with rolling review. Check the job board weekly from January and apply the day your target department appears.


### What GPA do I need for a Cape Cod 5 internship?


A minimum of 3.00 to 3.49, per Vault's profile of the program, which is well below the 3.5 many large banks expect. The range format and the behavioral interview suggest the bank looks at the whole candidate. A solid GPA plus customer-facing experience and a clear interest in community banking is the winning combination.


### How competitive is the Cape Cod 5 internship?


Selective for a community bank. The 2024 class of about 60 interns was chosen from nearly 700 applications, roughly 8 to 9 percent, and a Vault intern reviewer had heard a figure around 15 percent. The rolling process and accessible GPA floor make it more approachable than Wall Street programs, but early applicants have the edge.


### Are Cape Cod 5 internships paid?


Yes, all of them. The program page states every internship is paid, though the bank doesn't publish a rate. Indeed's aggregator estimate is about $17.71 per hour across seven postings. Over a full-time 10-week summer, that's roughly $7,000 before taxes. Glassdoor's annualized intern estimates run $41,000 to $65,000 but are less reliable.


### What departments offer internships at Cape Cod 5?


More than 15. The most visible are internal audit, residential and consumer lending, retail banking, wealth management, marketing, process excellence, and learning and development. Commercial lending, technology, accounting, risk and compliance, treasury operations, customer care, trust services and mortgage operations have also hosted interns. The recruiter matches you by resume and stated interest.


### What is the Cape Cod 5 interview like?


Conversational and behavioral, usually one round and always one-on-one. Glassdoor rates it 2 out of 5 for difficulty with 100 percent positive experiences across seven reviews. Expect questions about why Cape Cod 5, your customer-facing experience, your five-year plan and what you'd bring to the team. No case studies or online tests are reported.


### Can a Cape Cod 5 internship lead to a full-time job?


It can. Cape Cod 5 doesn't publish a conversion rate, but the program is built as a pipeline with real projects, leadership workshops and senior-leader exposure, and LinkedIn shows former interns, including an audit intern, accepting full-time offers. Strong performance and cultural fit are the deciding factors at a bank this size.


### Do I need to live on Cape Cod to apply?


No, but you need to be there for the summer. Cape Cod 5 welcomes students from schools across the country, and recent interns have come from as far as the University of South Florida. All placements are onsite or hybrid at Hyannis or a Cape banking center, so plan housing early if you're coming from off-Cape.


Cape Cod 5's summer 2027 postings are a few months out, which gives you time to become the candidate who names a department and brings a story about a customer.
